Level 6 is a Malphite spike, not an Irelia one, and the 57.81% win rate agrees. audit.whatIsWrong: Ionian Fervor is described four separate times as an armour 'shred' — 'four-stack passive shred', 'shred your armor', 'passive shred'. It shreds nothing. Separately, the decisive interaction of the matchup is absent from both layers.
audit.why: Riot's text for Ionian Fervor: stacking bonus ATTACK SPEED on hitting enemies with spells, plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. No resistance reduction anywhere in her kit. This matters because it inverts the advice: an attack-speed passive is exactly what Ground Slam's cripple counters, whereas a real armour shred would make stacking armour futile. The missing interaction: Defiant Dance reduces the PHYSICAL damage she takes while charging, but Ground Slam deals MAGIC damage based on Malphite's armour — so her W blunts your autos and does nothing to your E. That is the reason you press E into her charge instead of waiting it out.
audit.corrected: 'Shred' replaced with the attack-speed stacking it actually is, and the Defiant Dance versus Ground Slam damage-type interaction stated in both layers.
sources: champ-data/_kits/malphite.json (E: 'deals magic damage based on his Armor')

That error inverts the build advice, so it is the most important fix here. LEVEL-6 CONTRADICTION: both layers mark Level 6 as Irelia's stage while the level-6 spike text and whys[4] say R is your trump card — I proposed flipping phases[4].side to Malphite so the rating agrees with the prose already on the page. I did NOT propose changing content win[4] to match, because 'Irelia' to 'Malphite' is a 33% length change and the applier's length band would reject it; if the side flip is accepted, win[4] needs the same flip by hand or via mirror-fix. Malphite's R displacement immunity is web-verified (League Wiki: the dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control'), which is what makes the existing 'her Q dash and E stun can't interrupt your R' line correct. Irelia's Flawless Duet carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's description does not support (it describes a stun only) — I asserted nothing from it.
